description: Built at Oklahoma City in 1943 (c/n 13880) and delivered to the USAAF on 5 October 1943; served the Turkish Air Force 1949-1995 and was given to the Bundeswehr, arriving dismantled at Faßberg aboard the Airbus Beluga on 19 June 1998 and reassembled by the Luftwaffe technical school. Painted to represent the original Berlin Airlift Faßberg Flyer (C-47A-80-DL 43-19674), which is a different airframe.
aliases: C47; C-47A; Dakota; Skytrain; 4330729; A30DK; C47A30DK; C47A
